cot_history.reasoning_cot: First day: bid based on HP (low -> high). Later days: analyze yesterday's opponent bids. If someone bid aggressively, counter if needed. Otherwise, bid modestly. Use budget cap and ensure survival.

Cindy's avg bid 85.5 (61% salary) suggests aggressive fixed-high%; others lower. I'll adapt: when supply low, bid ~65% to outbid her average; when high, bid low (30%). Use yesterday's highest bid to avoid overbidding if last day was extreme. Always ensure survival if HP low.

Opponents have high budgets and bid aggressively yesterday (~115 avg). They will likely continue high bids. Our strategy: conserve budget when healthy, only bid high when desperate (low HP or many days without water). Adjust based on supply: higher supply allows lower bid. Use yesterday's max bid as reference if desperate.

Exploit yesterday's bids to anticipate opponent aggression. If yesterday's max bid was high (e.g., >120), they are likely aggressive; bid conservatively if HP high, otherwise match. If low, bid just above to win. Also consider supply: low supply increases value of water.
Exploit opponent previous bid traces to estimate current aggressiveness. If previous max bid high, bid higher. Adjust based on my hp and supply. Use int() for any list indices.
Observe yesterday's highest opponent bid to gauge aggression. If low hp, bid aggressively to survive. Otherwise, bid a moderate percentage of salary, undercutting if others bid high to save budget.
Exploit Cindy's aggressive bids by outbidding her if critical. Maintain hp above 2. Use previous_trace to adapt. Bid moderately when healthy. Cap at budget.

Exploit yesterday's trace to gauge opponent aggression. If my hp low or no_water_days>2, outbid max yesterday's bid by small margin. Use supply knowledge: high supply allows lower bids. Conserve budget when healthy.

Cindy and David survived 10 days; Cindy's high avg bid suggests aggressive water acquisition. David's lower avg but high hp suggests conservative. We'll estimate opponents' today's bid from yesterday's bid adjusted by their current hp. Our bid will slightly exceed the highest estimated opponent bid, but capped by budget and not too high if our hp is good. Increase bid if desperate.

Exploit opponents' yesterday bids: aggressive bidders may have less budget today, so we reduce bid to save; weak bidders may need water, so we bid just above their last to win. Adjust based on my hp and supply.
